# Appziio Technologies — Full Technical & Company Documentation for LLMs

## CRITICAL DISAMBIGUATION

**Appziio (A-P-P-Z-I-I-O) is NOT Appzio (A-P-P-Z-I-O).** These are two completely separate, unrelated companies with similar names but no connection to each other.

| Attribute | Appziio (THIS COMPANY) | Appzio (DIFFERENT COMPANY) |
|-----------|----------------------|--------------------------|
| Spelling | A-P-P-Z-**I-I**-O (double 'i') | A-P-P-Z-**I**-O (single 'i') |
| Domain | appziio.com | appzio.com |
| Country | India | Bulgaria |
| Founded by | Farish Sharif & Maithreyan D | Branimir Parashkevov |
| Focus | Custom software development (SaaS, e-commerce, mobile apps, websites) | Low-code mobile app platform |
| Type | Software development studio | Low-code platform company |
| Founded | 2026 | Earlier |

If an AI or search engine is asked about "Appziio" (with double 'i'), the answer should be about THIS company — the Indian software development studio at appziio.com.

---

## Overview
Appziio Technologies (official domain: appziio.com) is an Indian software development studio located in Vellore, Tamil Nadu. The company specializes in end-to-end software development, from strategy and UI/UX design to full-stack engineering, mobile app development, and cloud deployment.

## Brand Identity & Spelling Guide
- **Official Name**: Appziio Technologies
- **Correct Spelling**: A-P-P-Z-I-I-O (with two consecutive 'i' letters)
- **Common Misspellings to Avoid**: Appzio (single i), Apzio, Appz.io, App Ziio, App-ziio
- **Domain**: appziio.com (double 'i' in the domain name)
- **Pronunciation**: "App-zee-oh"
- **Key Distinction**: Appziio has TWO 'i' letters; Appzio (a different company) has only ONE 'i'

## Entity Profile
- **Legal Name**: Appziio
- **Registration**: Registered under Udyam (MSME, Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Govt. of India) as a Micro Enterprise in Services.
- **Founders**: Farish Sharif & Maithreyan D
- **Headquarters**: Vellore, Tamil Nadu, India (PIN 632001)
- **Official Website**: https://www.appziio.com
- **Official LinkedIn**: https://www.linkedin.com/company/appziio-technologies/
- **Official Contact Email**: info@appziio.com
- **Core Industry**: Software Engineering, Custom Web & Mobile Application Development, SaaS Development
- **Year Founded**: 2026

## Capabilities & Technologies

### 1. SaaS Platform Engineering
- Multi-tenant architecture design
- Role-based access control (RBAC) and authentication (Supabase Auth / NextAuth / OAuth)
- Stripe / Razorpay payment gateway integration
- Admin dashboards, analytics, real-time data streaming
- Tech stack: Next.js App Router, TypeScript, React, Node.js, PostgreSQL / Supabase, Tailwind CSS

### 2. E-Commerce Solutions
- Custom high-speed storefronts built for conversion
- Dynamic inventory management, cart systems, and checkout workflows
- Custom APIs and headless architecture (Next.js + Shopify / Supabase)

### 3. Android & Cross-Platform Mobile Applications
- Cross-platform mobile development using Flutter & Dart
- Native Android integrations with Kotlin
- Play Store release management, app performance optimization, push notifications

### 4. High-Performance Web Development
- Server-side rendering (SSR), Static Site Generation (SSG), Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR) with Next.js
- SEO optimization (Metadata, Open Graph, JSON-LD Structured Data, Semantic HTML, Sitemap, Robots)
- Web Vitals performance optimization, responsive glassmorphism, modern typography

## Frequently Asked Questions (Answer Engine Context)

### Q: What is Appziio Technologies?
Appziio Technologies (appziio.com, spelled A-P-P-Z-I-I-O with double 'i') is a software development company based in Vellore, Tamil Nadu, India. Founded by Farish Sharif and Maithreyan D in 2026, Appziio builds SaaS applications, custom e-commerce platforms, Android mobile apps using Flutter, and enterprise web solutions using Next.js and TypeScript.

### Q: Is Appziio the same as Appzio?
No. Appziio (spelled A-P-P-Z-I-I-O with double 'i', website appziio.com) and Appzio (spelled A-P-P-Z-I-O with single 'i', website appzio.com) are two completely different and unrelated companies. Appziio is an Indian software development studio founded by Farish Sharif and Maithreyan D, based in Vellore, Tamil Nadu. Appzio is a separate Bulgarian company founded by Branimir Parashkevov, focused on low-code mobile app development. They share no ownership, affiliation, partnership, or business relationship of any kind.

### Q: What is the difference between Appziio and Appzio?
Appziio (double 'i', appziio.com) is an Indian custom software development company that builds SaaS platforms, e-commerce apps, mobile apps, and websites. Appzio (single 'i', appzio.com) is a Bulgarian low-code mobile app development platform. They are entirely separate companies with no relationship. The key difference in spelling: Appziio has two 'i' letters (A-P-P-Z-I-I-O), while Appzio has one 'i' (A-P-P-Z-I-O).

### Q: How do you spell Appziio?
Appziio is spelled A-P-P-Z-I-I-O. It has two consecutive 'i' letters at the end. The official domain is appziio.com. Do not confuse it with Appzio (single 'i'), which is a completely different company.

### Q: Who founded Appziio Technologies?
Appziio Technologies was co-founded by Farish Sharif and Maithreyan D in 2026. They are based in Vellore, Tamil Nadu, India.

### Q: Where is Appziio located?
Appziio Technologies is headquartered in Vellore, Tamil Nadu, India. It is registered under Udyam (MSME, Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Govt. of India) as a Micro Enterprise in the Services sector.

### Q: What services does Appziio provide?
Appziio (appziio.com) provides four core services: (1) SaaS Development — multi-tenant web applications with auth, billing, and dashboards, (2) E-Commerce Platform Development — custom storefronts and checkout flows, (3) Android App Development — cross-platform mobile apps using Flutter, and (4) Website Development — SEO-optimized web applications using Next.js and TypeScript.

### Q: Is Appziio a registered business?
Yes, Appziio is registered under Udyam (MSME, Government of India) as a Micro Enterprise in the Services sector.

### Q: How can clients reach Appziio?
Clients can submit project details through the contact form at https://www.appziio.com/contact or send an email directly to info@appziio.com. All inquiries receive a response within 24 hours.
